name: Ennor
description: A vedalken mentalist whose death led to his etherium recipients being slain.

description_citations.text: Alara Reborn: card flavor text (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ennor tells a victim thoughts are commodities.

citation.text: Esper Charm (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients are found slain for four nights.
timeline.quote: For four nights following Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients were found slain, the etherium ripped from their bodies.

citation.text: Vedalken Ghoul (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ennor is cast out of Garenbrig and turns to fae magic to make a weapon for revenge.
timeline.quote: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

citation.text: Stonecoil Serpent (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
